title: Greeting example
general: Write your code in the field. Grey lines with a lock are fixed. Press Run to see the result and Check to submit.

help.t: A **variable** is a box with a name. The sign `=` means "put into the box": the name is on the left, the value on the right.
help.code: name = 'Anna'    # put the text 'Anna' into the box name

questions.text:
**What to do:** save the text `Anna` in the variable `name`.
**Expected result:** the console shows `Anna`.
**Where to look:** Help, "Lesson".
questions.about: Practice: storing a value in a variable.

questions.text:
**What to do:** in the field there is a line that prints `Hello`. Change it so the console shows `Hello, Anna`.
**Expected result:** the console shows `Hello, Anna`.
**Where to look:** Help, "Lesson".
